first line: 가볍게 접고,
second line: 다시 펼치다

Put restrained "FOLN" together with the release, preorder and full URL into ONE compact readable editorial group just beneath the common product grounding, using the SAME short-cup/typographic-block left alignment. FOLN is a supplied small text word, not a logo and no longer an isolated top brand zone. Release, preorder and URL are ordinary subordinate information, with calm normal/medium weight and close semantic grouping. All are clearly smaller than Fold Cup and smaller/quieter than the claim.
